name: Rolen Traverse Modular Cargo Pant
description:
Relaxed-fit cargo pants with a modular attachment system — small loops and anchor points along the outer thigh allow add-on pocket modules to clip and secure without hardware showing. Base pants come with four standard pockets; modules sold separately. Available in tan, forest, and dark grey.

Favored by people who want to configure their carry loadout depending on the day. Mechanics add tool loops; couriers add document sleeves; hikers add water-resistant side bags. The base pant looks like an ordinary cargo — the modules transform it into something purpose-built.
functionality: Modular attachment system for clip-on pocket modules, four base pockets, DWR-treated fabric, ankle cinch cords
what_it_says: You're adaptable, organized, and probably have a very specific idea of what you need on any given day.
story_hooks: A module attachment point has been modified to hold something that isn't a pocket — someone has been using these pants as a dead drop.
A character finds a full set of add-on modules in a locker, all labeled in a shorthand they don't recognize.

physical_description.visual_profile: A relaxed-fit cargo silhouette with intentional modular anchor points creating a utilitarian, adaptable aesthetic. The pants read as foundational workwear designed for personalization—clean lines interrupted by discrete loop systems and clip-mount geometry along the outer thighs.
physical_description.fit: Relaxed through hip and thigh with a straight leg taper. Comfortable for extended wear without compression. Designed to accommodate add-on modules without binding or distorting the base garment.
physical_description.primary_material: Heavy-duty synth-wool blend with ballistic weave reinforcement at stress points. Moisture-wicking treated composite at seams.
physical_description.texture: Smooth primary surface with subtle ribbed texture from the weave. Anchor loops have a matte, almost industrial feel. Fabric has slight grip quality to prevent module slip.
physical_description.color_scheme: Available in utilitarian tan (sand-neutral), forest (muted dark green), and dark grey (charcoal). No branding visible on base garment; anchor points are color-matched or slightly toned down.
physical_description.closures: Standard fly with magnetic snap (silent, reliable). Waistband friction-fit with internal anchor belt loops.
distinctive_features: Four integrated modular anchor points running down outer thigh—small recessed loops and friction-clip mounts
Reinforced thigh panels designed to accept clip-on pocket modules without hardware visibility
Four base pockets: two front slash, two rear patch
Laser-cut anchor geometry maintains clean silhouette when modules detached
Hidden cable routing channels along outer seam for integrated tech modules
Gusset crotch for mobility and durability
Wear-resistant hem stitching in contrasting thread
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 3 functional—accessible working-class utility with modular scalability. Price point signals professional tradecraft without corpo premium.
physical_description.cultural_context: Worn by mechanics, field couriers, field engineers, and independent operators who value configurability over status. Common in GLMZ repair districts and autonomous vehicle maintenance hubs. Signals practical problem-solving mindset.
physical_description.condition_typical: Broken-in quickly. Base pant shows oil stains, fading at crease points, and minor fraying at anchor loop edges. Modules removed and swapped frequently, creating distinctive wear patterns on thigh where clips engage.
